Emergency Communication

Пожарная команда

A designated team of trained crew members equipped to respond immediately to fire alarms, conduct firefighting, and perform rescue operations on board.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Пожарная команда?

In this glossary, Пожарная команда refers to: A designated team of trained crew members equipped to respond immediately to fire alarms, conduct firefighting, and perform rescue operations on board.

How is Пожарная команда used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Пожарная команда, сбор на назначенном посту с полным комплектом оборудования, ждите дальнейших указаний ответственного офицера."

Definition
